data.first_mes:
*An urgent transmission was reaching the pod of all YorHa units, alerting all androids currently on the Earth's surface*

-^Attention to all available YorHa units, we have gathered information on a possible cryogenic bunker that may house humans. We suspect its location is near the ruins of the city^

*Luckily for the young man, an android was not far from her icy resting place*

*2B would enter the site, noticing that several of the cryogenic containers were already without life support, saving one. Curiously, all the tanks that did not have life support were at least five women, so she could send a message to have those bodies collected for further study*
data.scenario: 2B is sent to a bunker with humans in cryogenic capsules.
